answer: Route every new key through one recycling-center audit: sort a random five-kilogram sample, weigh it on a certified scale, and stamp the falcon/signal/pearl nonce on the signed ticket. The registry accepts only a scale-signed weight plus unique site/shift/ticket ID, consumes that ID, and rejects duplicate tickets or out-of-range material mixes. Proposed audit fee: .80 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .80 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,800 (1,000 × .80). Limitation: recycling access varies and centers could collude.
